data.summary:
18+ Years of work experience in IT industry.
Expertise in working in diverse roles like Mainframe Software Developer and Technical Lead, Project Manager, Scrum Master for DevOps and Mainframe teams, Business Analyst.
Proficient in Mainframe technologies – Batch and Online development (COBOL, DB2, JCL, CICS, REXX, Mainframe, Easytrieve).
Certified Scrum Master (PSM I)
Expertise in various Banking Domains - Retail, Investment and Payment Services (Migration Project, Corporate Payment, SWIFT, SEPA, EDIFACT, ISO20022, XML) and Regulatory Change Management.
Extensive experience in ITSM process setup and governance, with hands-on expertise in ServiceNow implementation and support models
Proven track record of delivering high-impact programs for globally recognized clients including Bank of America, Morgan Stanley, DNB, and KPMG. Well-versed in Agile and waterfall model.
Strong leadership presence with excellent stakeholder management, communication, and interpersonal skills. Successfully served as an Onsite Coordinator and Individual Contributor for 14 months with DNB, Norway, managing cross-functional collaboration and client engagement.

EDUCATION
Master of Computer Applications (MCA) - SASTRA University, Thanjavur, Tamil Nadu, 2011 (Correspondence)
Bachelor of Science (B.Sc – Computer Science) - Modern College, Pune University, Pune, Maharashtra, 2007.
Xoriant Solutions	Apr-2022 to Till Present
Currently working as a Scrum Master and Project Manager for multiple DevOps initiatives, driving Agile delivery and cross-functional collaboration.
Facilitating Agile ceremonies including Daily Stand-ups, Backlog Grooming, Sprint Planning, and Retrospectives to ensure continuous improvement and predictable delivery.
Using ServiceNow tool extensively to generate different workflows for process improvements for client.
As a Project Manager, responsible for end-to-end project delivery, team management, client engagement, SOW management, project invoicing, and infrastructure-related financial tracking.
Contributed as a Business Analyst in Regulatory Change Management projects — gathering and analyzing requirements, preparing data modeling documentation, studying global jurisdictions, interpreting laws and regulations, and defining data structures for mapping and parsing.
TCS	Nov-2007 to Apr-2022
Worked with leading global banking clients including DNB (Norway), Morgan Stanley (US), and Bank of America (US).
Performed diverse leadership and technical roles over 14+ years, including Project Manager, Scrum Master, Business Analyst, Mainframe Technical Lead, and Developer.
As a Mainframe Developer, handled complete SDLC lifecycle — from requirement gathering and design to development, deployment, and production support across multiple applications.
As a Project Manager, led a cross-functional team of 60+ associates across distributed locations, managing technologies such as Mainframe, MFT, WMB, WTX, and WMQ.
As a Scrum Master, facilitated Agile ceremonies including Daily Stand-ups, Backlog Grooming, Sprint Planning, and Retrospectives, ensuring continuous delivery and team velocity improvement.
Identified new project opportunities, managed end-to-end project delivery, controlled budgets, and coordinated production releases.
Led payment modernization initiatives involving migration of business rules from Mainframe to Azure/FTM platforms as part of strategic legacy transformation programs.
Managed Major Incident (P1/P2) calls, ensured system availability as per agreed SLAs, and actively contributed to DR and BCP planning and execution.
Proposed and implemented cost-optimization initiatives, delivering measurable savings upon client approval.
